summary: Operator reported minor TUI bug: terminal remains painted after Jarvis exit. Inspected Client/Modules/TerminalMouse.Tracking and ConsoleTui.RunInputLoop and Client/Program.fs. Root issue: Tracking.stopSequence restored mouse modes/cursor/color but did not clear viewport; Tracking scope was inside input loop, which could finish before SignalR Closed callback SetConnectionState/Log redrew. Implemented isolated branch fix/terminal-clear-on-exit from main f1a83ff2 in registered worktree lead-terminal-clear-on-exit: Tracking.stopSequence disables mouse, restores cursor, SGR and OSC default background then ANSI CSI2J + CSIH clear viewport/home cursor without wiping scrollback; moved use tracking = Client.TerminalMouse.Tracking.enable() from ConsoleTui.RunInputLoop to runClient enclosing task, so terminal is restored/cleared only after connection.DisposeAsync and inputLoop finalization (even on exception/cancellation). Added TerminalMouseTests terminalExitRestoresModesAndClearsViewport regression on exact sequence and order, no CSI3J.
